title: The chat panel in the Frequency look: an orb that changes colour with the view and flickers while a reply is coming

source.ref: Daniel 2026-10-19 design changes list, items 14 and 15

detail: The bottom-right panel (Messages, Vera, Help and support) wears the Frequency look: a pastel header, a card surface, the pastel pill for primary actions. A header orb is Vera blue, Support green or Messages pink, and flickers while Vera's reply is arriving (VeraChat announces it on fq-dock-busy). The same orb sits beside 'Vera is thinking'. The closed tab (the rail's .fqm-vera-btn) is not touched. The orb ships hidden, so DAWN is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const css=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-shell.css','utf8');for(const m of ['vera','support','messages'])if(!css.includes('.fqd-orb[data-mode=\"'+m+'\"]')&&m!=='vera')bad.push('css lacks '+m+' orb');if(!/\.fqd-orb\[data-busy=\"true\"\]\{animation:fqd-flicker/.test(css))bad.push('css lacks the flicker');const l=fs.readFileSync('components/vera/vera-launcher.tsx','utf8');if(!l.includes('<DockOrb mode={orbMode}'))bad.push('launcher lacks the orb');if(!fs.readFileSync('components/vera/vera-chat.tsx','utf8').includes('announceDockBusy(pending)'))bad.push('vera chat does not announce busy');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1025: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Support or Messages orb colour, the flicker, the launcher's orb, or Vera's busy announcement is removed.
